title: River Development Agent Governed Executor Integration Handoff Foundation
objective: Create a deterministic fail-closed inert handoff from the exact accepted DEV-293 governed executor integration acceptance result to a future explicit downstream boundary without creating authorization, invoking an executor, executing an operation, or modifying repository state.
requirements: DEV-293 predecessor identity and source must be exact.
DEV-293 must remain trusted, ready, and accepted.
DEV-293 acceptance state must be GOVERNED_EXECUTOR_INTEGRATION_ACCEPTED.
DEV-293 acceptance must remain decision-only and inert data.
DEV-293 must contain no blocked reasons.
DEV-293 must grant no prohibited authority.
Verification state and evidence must be preserved only when handoff-ready.
Acceptance evidence must be preserved only when handoff-ready.
The handoff must remain inert data.
Any downstream authorization or action requires a separate explicit future boundary.
